summary: The hosts discuss the aftermath of Trump's inauguration week, noting that the strategic Bitcoin reserve expectations were not met and instead a broader crypto reserve was mentioned. They view the Trump and Melania meme coin launches as unprecedented but potentially damaging to the meme coin sector. Bitcoin is range-bound between 99k and all-time highs, with both hosts watching 99k as key invalidation. ETH remains a long-term bet with $4K as the critical breakout level. Solana and XRP benefit from the US coin narrative under Trump.
